handbook-tallow-text: Melt rendered fat in a cooking pot. Leave the pot on a burning firepit to keep the tallow molten, and hold right-click on the firepit with a dipping rod to give its wicks a coat. Let each coat set before the next. Six coats make finished tapers; cut them free with a knife. Off the fire, the tallow soon sets back into rendered fat.
dippingrod-setting: The last coat is still soft
dippingrod-finished: Finished - cut the candles free with a knife
ingameerror-rodfinished: These tapers are finished - cut them free with a knife
ingameerror-notallow: Needs a pot of molten tallow on the fire
ingameerror-tallowcold: The tallow has gone cold - rekindle the fire
ingameerror-coatsetting: Let the last coat set first
